environment: Windows x64, Windows PowerShell 5.1, pristine CPython 3.12.10 embeddable, Microsoft Edge
resolved_findings: Use UTF-8 for embedded Python JSON output.
Use the Win32 show-window constant supported by standard Python.
Use .NET SHA256 rather than depending on PowerShell module autoloading.
Validate GUI view metadata before launching a candidate project.
limitations: A pristine runtime and relocated installation were tested on the development Windows host, not a separate clean computer.
Windows paths around 280 characters failed where OS long-path support was unavailable; use a short writable extraction/session path.
macOS and Linux GUI support was not tested.
No Spectre simulation was rerun for this packaging task; historical simulation coverage is described separately.
Test counts describe overlapping layers and must not be summed as independent end-to-end cases.
